entries.subject: EVS
entries.description:
Let's grow a plant:
Take a pot or an old cardboard box.
❖ Fill the box with soil. Take a handful of mustard seeds. Push the seeds into the soil, and cover the seeds with some soil.
❖ Pour a little water over the soil every day.
❖ After 4-5 days, you will see small mustard plants grow from the soil.
Let's draw it:
❖ Once the mustard plants become a little big, carefully pull out one of the plants. Make sure the roots also come out.
❖ Now draw the plant on an A4 size paper.
❖ Colour it and then name the different parts of the plant.
❖ Did the mustard plant have all the five parts you learnt about? Which parts were not there?
Submit the A4 paper on 16-11-26
